title: Rice paper chicken nuggets
summary: Seasoned chicken mince rolled in rice paper, cut into thirty nuggets and air fried until the wrapper shatters. No breadcrumbs, no frying, and 45 g of protein a portion.

time.note: Makes 30 nuggets, 10 a serving. The rolling is the slow part.

nutrition_per_serving.note: Ten nuggets plus a third of the dip. Works out near 32 calories a nugget, with the dip adding about 50 on top.

ingredients.note: Has to be mince. The whole method depends on it binding into a log you can roll and slice.
This is the entire crust. It goes glassy in the air fryer and shatters like batter.
Not for lift. It raises the pH of the mince and keeps it tender, which is what stops air fried chicken going dry and bouncy.

ingredients.qty: cooking spray, for the baskets and the nuggets
ingredients.note: Do not skip it. Unsprayed rice paper dries leathery instead of crisping.

steps: Mix the mince with the egg, mozzarella, baking soda and all the seasoning until it is properly uniform. Work it a bit longer than feels necessary - the mixture should hold together when you squeeze it, or the rolls will not slice cleanly.

Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for a few seconds, until it is only just pliable. Take it out while it still feels slightly stiff; it keeps softening on the board, and a sheet left in the water tears as soon as you handle it.
Lay the sheet flat and shape a log of mince along one edge, then roll it up tight. Air pockets in the roll turn into hollow nuggets.
Cut each roll crosswise into about 6 pieces. Five sheets gives you 30.
Spray the nuggets and the basket, then air fry at 200C for 15 to 20 minutes, shaking halfway. Give them room - crowded nuggets weld to each other and the wrapper never crisps.
Stir the yogurt, mayo, garlic paste and a little salt together for the dip, loosening with water until it pours.
tips: Rice paper is the whole trick here. It hydrates, wraps, then dehydrates in the dry heat into something closer to a crisp shell than a breadcrumb coating.
Wear gloves, or work with wet hands. The soaked sheets stick to dry skin and tear.
They go soft if you stack them hot. Cool them in a single layer.
Reheat in the air fryer, never the microwave - the wrapper goes chewy and does not come back.
health_notes: Nearly all the protein is the mince, and at 500 g of lean chicken across three portions that is 45 g each before the dip. The rice paper is close to pure starch, so it is where most of the carbohydrate comes from despite weighing very little.

source.title: The CRISPIEST Low Calorie Chicken Nuggets! 116g of protein for the plate!
source.adapted: Ingredients and method are from the pinned comment, confirmed against the video. Nutrition is recorded per portion of ten nuggets rather than the video's per-nugget and whole-plate figures, and it includes the dip, which the video's plate total leaves out. The video's 29 g carbs for the plate also looks low: five full size rice paper sheets are roughly 48 g of carbohydrate on their own, so the figure here is higher.
